comment_regular: Verified deferred PGRI resolver. For each PGRI row, low u16 is a local point-array index and XYZ at +4 locates the remote point; it adds reciprocal adjacency if absent and emits the reciprocal request on the remote grid. Out-of-range local indices are removed. Caller is TESPathGrid_LoadOrResolveGraph.
